attributes.board_name: Indiana State Board of Nursing (Professional Licensing Agency)

rules.accepted_credit_types: Programs approved by a nationally approved sponsor of continuing education for advanced practice nurses (e.g. US Dept. of Education, accredited colleges, Joint Commission, government agencies, national APRN organizations and their affiliates)
rules.new_licensee_rule: Prescriptive authority granted less than 12 months before expiry: no CE; 12-24 months before expiry: 15 contact hours incl. 4 pharmacology.
rules.alternatives: In an audit, proof of national certification may be submitted in lieu of the 30 contact hours.
rules.audit_note: APRN audit every two years of CE and collaborative practice agreements; keep certificates 3 years.
rules.notes: The APRN license in Indiana is the prescriptive authority license; it expires Oct 31 of odd years with the Indiana RN license (APRN-Compact RN: with the home-state RN license). Indiana RNs have no CE requirement, so these 30 hours are APRN-only.
